# authwise_guard_invite (Data Source)

An invite that admits people to a Guard network, with the grants every node it creates receives. Its `code` and `url` are shown once, so they are kept in state: treat the state as sensitive. A spent or expired invite stays in state; replace it to issue a new one. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String, Sensitive)
- `config` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `grants` (List of String)
- `guard_invite_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `max_uses` (Number)
- `network_id` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `url` (String, Sensitive)
- `uses` (Number)
